# Identifying pathway names
```{r find the exact pathway names}
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(pw_mia_strat))
unique(tax_df$pathway_name) %>%
    grep("lysine", ., value = TRUE)
```

## All pathways in saliva at week 4, genus level contribution
```{r extract rows beloning to pathway}
tax_phylo <- pw_mia_strat %>% 
  subset_samples(Sample == "Saliva" & Period == "Week 4") %>% 
  subset_taxa(pathway_name %in% c("pyrimidine deoxyriboNucleot. de novo Bios. IV", 
                                  "GDP-mannose Bios.", 
                                  "SPWY. of UDP-glucose-derived O-antigen building blocks Bios.", 
                                  "pyruvate Ferm. to acetate and lactate II", 
                                  "pyruvate Ferm. to acetate and (S)-lactate I", 
                                  "5-aminoimidazole ribonucleotide Bios. II", 
                                  "SPWY. of 5-aminoimidazole ribonucleotide Bios.", 
                                  "5-aminoimidazole ribonucleotide Bios. I", 
                                  "S-adenosyl-L-methionine salvage I", 
                                  "inosine-5'-phosphate Bios. III", 
                                  "adenine and adenosine salvage III", 
                                  "guanosine riboNucleot. de novo Bios.", 
                                  "inosine-5'-phosphate Bios. II", 
                                  "folate transf. II (plants)", 
                                  "O-antigen building blocks Bios. (E. coli)", 
                                  "glycogen Degrad. II", 
                                  "SPWY. of purine Nucleot. de novo Bios. I", 
                                  "UMP Bios. III", 
                                  "UMP Bios. II", 
                                  "UMP Bios. I", 
                                  "chorismate Bios. from 3-dehydroquinate", 
                                  "UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-pentapeptide Bios. I (meso-diaminopimelate containing)", 
                                  "chorismate Bios. I",
                                  "peptidoglycan Bios. I (meso-diaminopimelate containing)", 
                                  "L-lysine Ferm. to acetate and butanoate")) 

# Extract taxonomy
tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(tax_phylo))
tax$Genus[is.na(tax$Genus) | tax$Genus %in% c("", "NA", "unclassified", "Unclassified", "g__")] <- "Unclassified"
tax$feature <- rownames(tax)

# Extract OTU
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(tax_phylo)) 
otu$feature <- rownames(otu)

df <- left_join(otu, tax, by = "feature")

otu_genus <- df %>%
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus)) %>%
  group_by(pathway_id, pathway_name, Genus, Superclass2) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop")

# Extract metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(tax_phylo))

meta <- structure(meta, class = "data.frame", row.names = rownames(meta))

meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)
```

```{r calculate species richness per sample}
richness_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("S_"), names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
  filter(Abundance > 0) %>%   # only species that are present
  group_by(pathway_name, Superclass2, Period, Genus, Sample, Inflammation_response) %>%
  summarise(n_species = n_distinct(Species),.groups = "drop")

richness_long <- richness_long %>%
  mutate(Group = if_else(Genus == "Unclassified", "Unclassified","Classified"))

richness_legend_levels <- c(setdiff(levels(richness_long$Genus), "Unclassified"), "Unclassified")

richness_long <- richness_long %>%
  mutate(Genera = factor(Genus, levels = richness_legend_levels))
```

```{r}
richness_df <- richness_long %>%
  filter(Group == "Classified") %>%
  distinct(pathway_name, Superclass2, Sample, Period, Genus, n_species, Inflammation_response) %>% 
  mutate(Superclass2 = stringr::str_wrap(Superclass2, width = 15))
```

```{r calculate genus level contribution}
otu_long <- otu_genus %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("S_"), names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(Genus = trimws(Genus), Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus), Genus = factor(Genus)) %>%
  group_by(pathway_name, Sample, Period, Genus, Superclass2, Inflammation_response) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

otu_long <- otu_long %>%
  mutate(Group = if_else(Genus == "Unclassified", "Unclassified","Classified"))

legend_levels <- c(setdiff(levels(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified"), "Unclassified")

otu_long <- otu_long %>%
  mutate(Genera = factor(Genus, levels = legend_levels)) %>% 
  mutate(Superclass2 = stringr::str_wrap(Superclass2, width = 15))
```

```{r create color palette}
all_genus <- unique(as.character(otu_long$Genus))

other <- setdiff(all_genus, "Unclassified")

fill_colors <- c("Unclassified" = "#DF8F4499", setNames(viridis::viridis(length(setdiff(unique(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified")), option = "turbo"), setdiff(unique(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified")))
```

```{r same ordering in both plots}
# Use the current species richness ordering as the reference
superclass_levels <- richness_df %>%
  distinct(Superclass2) %>%
  arrange(Superclass2) %>%
  pull(Superclass2)

# Apply the same wrapping and superclass ordering to otu_long
otu_long <- otu_long %>%
  mutate(Superclass2 = str_wrap(as.character(Superclass2), width = 15),
         Superclass2 = factor(Superclass2, levels = superclass_levels))

# Make sure richness_df uses the same factor levels
richness_df <- richness_df %>%
  mutate(Superclass2 = factor(Superclass2, levels = superclass_levels))
```

```{r plot species richness}
richness_p <- ggplot(richness_df, aes(x = n_species, y = Inflammation_response)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6) + 
  facet_nested(Superclass2 + pathway_name ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y", 
               strip = ggh4x::strip_nested(text_y = ggh4x::elem_list_text(angle = c(0, 0), size = c(7, 8)), by_layer_y = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "Species richness", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.switch.pad.grid = unit(0, "mm"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

richness_p
```

```{r}
richness_grob <- ggplotGrob(richness_p)

strip_ids <- grep("^strip-l-", richness_grob$layout$name)

superclass_width <- unit(35, "mm")

# Preserve the existing pathway strip width
pathway_width <- richness_grob$grobs[[strip_ids[1]]]$widths[2]

for (i in strip_ids) {
  strip_grob <- richness_grob$grobs[[i]]

  strip_grob$widths[1] <- superclass_width
  strip_grob$widths[2] <- pathway_width

  richness_grob$grobs[[i]] <- strip_grob
}

# Update the total width of the nested strip column
strip_col <- richness_grob$layout$l[strip_ids[1]]

richness_grob$widths[strip_col] <- superclass_width + pathway_width

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(richness_grob)
```

```{r}
ggsave("/Volumes/lnp524/PhD/Puplications/Inflammation_trajectories/07_tax_contribution/species_richness_week4_saliva_p.png", plot = richness_grob, dpi = 500, units = "cm", width = 36, height = 46)
```

```{r plot genus contribution}
week4_saliva <- ggplot(otu_long,
  aes(x = Abundance, y = Inflammation_response, fill = Genera)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_nested(Superclass2 + pathway_name ~ Group, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y", 
               strip = ggh4x::strip_nested(text_y = ggh4x::elem_list_text(angle = c(0, 0), size = c(7, 8)), by_layer_y = TRUE)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, drop = FALSE) + 
  labs(x = "Average genus contribution to pathway", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.switch.pad.grid = unit(0, "mm"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.justification = "center", legend.box.just = "center",
        legend.location = "plot",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7), legend.key.height = unit(3, "mm")) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE, ncol = 6, byrow = FALSE))

week4_saliva
```

```{r}
week4_grob <- ggplotGrob(week4_saliva)

strip_ids <- grep("^strip-l-", week4_grob$layout$name)

superclass_width <- unit(35, "mm")
pathway_width <- unit(10, "cm")

for (i in strip_ids) {
  strip_grob <- week4_grob$grobs[[i]]

  strip_grob$widths[1] <- superclass_width
  strip_grob$widths[2] <- pathway_width

  week4_grob$grobs[[i]] <- strip_grob
}

strip_col <- week4_grob$layout$l[strip_ids[1]]

week4_grob$widths[strip_col] <- superclass_width + pathway_width

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(week4_grob)
```

```{r}
ggsave("/Volumes/lnp524/PhD/Puplications/Inflammation_trajectories/07_tax_contribution/genus_contribution_week4_saliva_p.png", plot = week4_grob, dpi = 500, units = "cm", width = 36, height = 50)
```
